# Equipment Checkout

## Overview
Staff check tools in and out. Express server with a React front end, PostgreSQL through Drizzle, and Replit Auth.

## System Architecture
- Frontend: React, Vite, wouter, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui
- Backend: Express, Drizzle ORM, Neon serverless PostgreSQL
- Auth: Replit Auth (OpenID Connect) with sessions in PostgreSQL
